# Truth sheet: ChatGPT

> Fixture for the story-scope selftests: run6's ChatGPT truth sheet (GPT-6 Intelligent UI, a 30 s launch), trimmed and
> corrected with the claim's scope (.context/night/S3-niche-diagnosis.md section 5a). Claim ids are run6's research/claims.json.

## Product

name: ChatGPT
does: You ask in plain words, and ChatGPT answers, now with a working tool built for your exact question when a tool is the better answer.

## Format

format: launch
length: 30
aspect: 16:9

## Claim scope

scope: universal
why: "make everyday answers more visual, learning complex topics easier, and quickly create a tool to solve a task in the moment" [c1]
clauses: everyday answers more visual; learning complex topics easier; a tool to solve a task in the moment
audience: mass
series: no

- learn: "GDP explained simply" [c15] (reach: many; prompt only)
- learn: "Monty Hall problem" [c15] (reach: some; prompt only)

## Tone

## Audience

Everyday ChatGPT users: more than 1.2 billion people each week [c4]. They know ChatGPT as the box you type into and the paragraphs that come back.

## Transformation

from "I asked a simple thing and got a wall of text" to "whatever I ask, the answer is something I can tap, drag and use" [c1, c2].

## Emotional truth

The small letdown everyone has had: you asked for help and got paragraphs to read. The relief is an answer you can use at once, whatever you asked [c18].

## Enemy

- The wall of text: a question that needed a calculator, a plan or a picture and got paragraphs instead
- The fixed app you have to learn, instead of software that adapts to you [c18]

## Native objects

- The pill composer with "+" at left, the "Ask ChatGPT" placeholder, the "Instant" picker, mic and send button [c31]
- The pale green user bubble [c32]
- The single green dot that means ChatGPT is thinking [c32]
- The black caret blinking in the composer [c31]
- Text streaming in word by word [b5]
- The generated clipboard card: THE DINNER LEDGER, "The Check, Please." [c10]
- The Roth calculator's sliders and the $416,129 headline [c11]
- The roast planner's "Number of people" stepper [c13]
- The blossom mark, black on white [b3]

## Proof

- c1: GPT-6 Intelligent UI answers with fully interactive interfaces and can quickly create a tool to solve a task in the moment
- c4: more than 1.2 billion people use ChatGPT each week
- c11: Roth IRA calculator, $416,129 after 30 years at $500/month
- c12: retro console prompt answered with a playable game

## Surprising facts

- The tool assembles itself on screen while it streams [c7].

## Must-show features

- Intelligent UI: any ask comes back as a working tool, streamed into the chat (the hero is the range, not one demo) [c1, c7]
